candidates.statement: Inventory's redis.reserve_inventory calls time out (1650 ms, ERROR), with 10 redis_operation_timeout 504 log events and 27 dependency_timeouts; inventory p95 rises to 1080 ms, propagating latency/errors up through order to gateway checkout.
candidates.uncertainty: Redis-side telemetry (server latency, saturation, connection pool) is absent; the deployment record alone does not establish causation.

report.explanation: Inventory traces and logs show redis operation timeouts with elevated dependency_timeouts and p95, and gateway traces show an errored downstream inventory call. This supports a bounded redis-timeout candidate; gateway/order metrics remain healthy, so no broader fault is claimed.
missing_evidence: Redis server-side latency, saturation, and connection-pool metrics for the incident window
Order-service traces showing propagation from inventory to gateway checkout
